description: Firmware driver for STM32F4xx FLASH hardware abstraction layer, including functions for programming, erasing, and error handling of internal flash memory.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program
methods.description: Programs byte, halfword, word, or double word at a specified address, with polling for completion.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program_IT
methods.description: Programs data at a specified address with interrupt enabled.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the FLASH control register access.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Lock
methods.description: Locks the FLASH control register access.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OB_Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the FLASH option control registers.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OB_Lock
methods.description: Locks the FLASH option control registers.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OB_Launch
methods.description: Launches the option byte loading process.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_GetError
methods.description: Returns the current FLASH error code.

methods.name: FLASH_WaitForLastOperation
methods.description: Waits for the last FLASH operation to complete or timeout.
